## Results

| Compound | PubChem CID | Formula | MW (Da) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Androstenonol propionate | 27692 | C₂₂H₃₂O₃ | 344.5 |
| Dromostanolone (= drostanolone) | 6011 | C₂₀H₃₂O₂ | 304.5 |

The propionate ester is heavier by ~40 Da. Notably, the conclusion is robust to the plausible reading of the first name as *androstanolone* (dihydrotestosterone) propionate, CID 13328, C₂₂H₃₄O₃ = 346.5 Da — still heavier than dromostanolone.

**Concerns:** (1) PubChem returned the molecular weight for CID 27692 as the malformed string `"-344.5"` (negative sign artifact); the formula-consistent value is 344.5 Da. (2) The first compound's name is ambiguous/possibly a misspelling: the literal string maps to CID 27692 (androst-1-en-3-one-17β-ol propionate), whereas "androstanolone propionate" is CID 13328 (C₂₂H₃₄O₃, 346.5 Da). Both candidates are heavier than dromostanolone, so the answer is unaffected. (3) "Dromostanolone" is a synonym of drostanolone, so the two names refer to the same compound.
